violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. -Char broiler grill top is missing one section. -Worn Teflon at tabletop grill/food press.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Frost build up in freezer compartment of under counter fridge. -Frost at interior edges of chest freezer. -Debris at bottom interior of 2 door stainless fridge. -Carbon/debris under bottom surface of oven.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Hand sink used as dump sink for ice water (used for cold hold) from prep table.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. -Beans found in hot hold at 120F.--Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Foods at cold make table found at 45-46F.*Using ice packs and ice bins in unit due to cold make table no longer working. A replacement cold table has been ordered. -2 door stainless refrigerator found with foods at 44-45f. *Staff have been in and out of unit frequently for prep. Ensure unit returns to/maintains food at 41F or less.

Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. > No documentation of certified servsafe manager. Gave owner resources for CFSM.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. > When measuring temperatures at the left side refrigerator (Prep line) temperatures came out to 48 degrees F. Food was also being cooled in this space. Moved foods to different fridge.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. > Behind front counter - constructed of raw wood material. Seal or paint over to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. > Charbroiler/grill top is in need of repair. Unit is collapsing on itself.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. > Many ceiling tiles are in need of repair/replacement towards the back of the kitchen area and office space.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. > Behind the cooking equipment needs cleaned more thoroughly.
